method: Sum over M~Binomial(N,d) of Pr[exact two-sided binomial p<=alpha and W>M/2 | W~Binomial(M,w)]. Holm first threshold alpha=.05/5; 10-cell joint-family sensitivity also given. Target 80% directional power. Minimum N found by exhaustive integer search.
